The '''Scarlet Prison''' is the second area of the [[Scarlet Monastery Graveyard]]. The entry is found in the [[Chamber of Atonement]], and in the prison complex below the torture chambers lies [[Duke Dreadmoore]], a harbinger of the Dread Citadel [[Naxxramas]] waiting for the right moment to break free.
